Introduction
This
document outlines the testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an
annually basses as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
The
first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Aly Aly Hassan tested by eng. Al shahat Ahmed Mousa at 01 Sep.
2003, revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Adel Al-nagar,
accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Abdel Mawla Meligy,
and approved by eng. Yousry Mohamed Aly Salama Head Sector of Elshabab GT Power
Station
The
Protection Scheme consist of:
1.
Differential protection Relay { F
305 }
2. Earth Fault protection Relay { F
317 }
3. Over current protection Relay { F 301}
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and
the qualified maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution
marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, safety
shoes . etc.

Tools and Equipment

Work to be Carried Out
Connect the relay testing units (
 Sverker ) to a power source.
Connect the timer to power source and its terminals
 to the trip terminals the relay test.
Put an ammeter on current leads of testing unit to
 measure the current and connect the volt meter in parallel with the
 voltage leads testing unit to measure the voltage.
Review the manual .
Prepare the previous results of the relay testing.
Be sure that the CB unit and the transformer are
 disconnected and DC source is available .
Differential Relay F305
Inject 0.4 Amp. to
 operating coil to terminals ( 3,1), (7,1), (11,1) 66
 KV SIDE
Record Results .
Inject 1.6 Amp. to operating coil to terminals (2,5
 ), (6,5), (10,5) 11.5KV Side
Record results .
Over Current Relay F301 type ITY192-232
Inject 1.4 Amp. to
 operating coil to terminal (1,2 ), ( 3, 4), (5, 6)
 operating coil after Time lag (2.76 sec.)
Record results for
 SC
 current.
Inject 6 Amp. to operating
 coil to terminals ( 1,2 ), ( 3,4), ( 5,6 ) time direction (0) sec.
Record Results.
Earth Fault protection
F317
Inject 86 VAC to operating coil to terminal (
 133, 136 )
Record results.
Putting the Protection
Relays into service
Check that
 the CT and PT secondary
 connection return to its normal position as before the test .
Close the
 terminal side protection .
